jobs.occupation: Kitchen Help Industrial Kitchen - Aalter - 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
Vol-au-vent, tomato soup with meatballs, or a perfectly cooked roast beef: you’ll be licking your fingers and thumbs. And in this role, you’ll make sure others can do the same. In our kitchen, we create dishes that would make grandmothers jealous—but on an industrial scale, in large quantities.

We’re looking for a Kitchen Help for a food company in Aalter!

Hygiene is crucial for a kitchen staff member. That’s why you’ll ensure every day that your work methods and the final products meet all standards.

You’ll also follow safety regulations to the letter. You’ll do everything in your power to guarantee both quality and safety. 

Who are you?

• You have experience as a cook in a commercial or industrial kitchen. Do you also have experience in a production environment? If so, that’s a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system.
• The early shift starts at 4:30 a.m. and runs until 12:30 p.m.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 p.m. and runs until 8:00 p.m. 
• You know how to operate machinery or are willing to undergo training for this.
• Physical work doesn’t deter you, and you’re hands-on.
• You work with great precision and are flexible and able to handle stress.
• You’re a good communicator, enjoy variety, and like working in a team.
• You speak Dutch or English well.

Are you hands-on, quality-focused, and looking for a stable production job? Then this opportunity could be a great fit for you!

You will help produce high-quality safety boots used in industries such as agriculture, food production, construction, and fishing.
Your Responsibilities
• Assemble components onto moulds before production
• Operate production machines together with a colleague
• Remove finished boots from the machine
• Clean and prepare machines for the next production cycle
• Trim and finish products by removing excess material
• Carry out detailed quality inspections
• Ensure every product meets the required quality standards

Your Profile

• Experience in a production environment is an advantage
• You are willing to learn and develop new skills
• You work accurately and have a strong eye for detail
• Quality is your top priority
• You enjoy working closely with colleagues and supporting the team
• You have your own transportation
• You speak English or Dutch and English (you are able to follow training and work instructions in English)Working Environment
• Modern manufacturing environment
• Standing work throughout most of the shift
• Team-oriented workplace with colleagues from different nationalities (Polish, Ukrainian, Hungarian etc)
• Production targets are important, but quality always comes first
• Product inspection and quality control are a key part of the job

• After thorough training by an experienced colleague, you will independently perform cutting and bending operations.
• You will calculate flat patterns and program the sheet metal processing machines.
• Using technical drawings, you will learn to independently carry out various metalworking operations such as bending, cutting, deburring, tapping, and other machining processes on workpieces.

• You have an A2 degree in Mechanics or equivalent experience.
• You have knowledge of a guillotine shear, press brake, corner notcher, and punching machine.
• You can read and interpret technical drawings.
• Good spatial insight is essential.
• You work accurately and can work independently after the training period.
• Order, cleanliness, and safety are second nature to you.
• English or Dutch.

For a company in Aalter that specializes in structural steel, I’m looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician!

What will your responsibilities be?

• You’ll thoroughly troubleshoot and resolve malfunctions in machines and systems.
• You’ll work in a technical team where everyone is committed to optimization.
• You’ll strictly adhere to safety regulations.
• You’ll conduct quality checks.

Who are you?

• You have a technical mindset! This is reflected in your experience or technical training.
• You preferably have knowledge of pneumatic, hydraulic, and/or mechanical systems.
• You have experience with preventive maintenance.
• You are passionate about troubleshooting and resolving issues.
• You speak English or Dutch.
• Polish or Romanian is a plus!

Do you have experience as a forklift driver and a valid forklift certificate?

Are you willing to work in shifts and in a fast-paced production environment?

This internationally growing production company specializes in innovative solutions for the construction and interior sector and is known for its strong focus on quality and sustainability. They are currently looking for forklift drivers to join their team in Desselgem in a stable and modern working environment.

What will you do?

jobs.occupation: Line Leader Slicing - Meat Company | Oudenaarde | 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
For a growing food production company in Oudenaarde, we are looking for a Line Leader Slicing. The company specializes in slicing and packaging ham products for various supermarket chains.

As a Line Leader, you will be responsible for the smooth operation of the slicing line. You will coordinate the production process, support and supervise operators, ensure product quality, and make sure all hygiene and safety standards are respected.

Your Responsibilities

• Leading and supporting employees on the slicing line.
• Setting up, monitoring, and adjusting production machines.
• Ensuring product quality and correct packaging.
• Solving minor machine issues and reporting technical problems.
• Monitoring compliance with hygiene, quality, and safety regulations.
• Following up on production targets and reporting results.
The job is not physically demanding!

Early shift: 5:00 a.m.–1:30 p.m.

Late shift: 1:30 p.m.–10:00 p.m.

You get a half-hour break.

Profile

• Previous experience in a production environment is required, preferably within the food industry.
• Experience as a team leader, supervisor, or line leader is an advantage.
• You are detail-oriented and quality-focused.
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system.
• You have good communication and leadership skills.
• You will speak in English, Polish or Ukrainian with your colleagues

jobs.occupation: Cream Consulting by Audensiel - Business Analyst Business Intelligence
jobs.description:
We could be a Cream Factory, a cooking blog or even a detective agency...

But in reality, we are a Business & Technology consulting company, active in large organizations and industry leaders in Banking, Insurance, Telecom, Energy, & Transport.

 

The cream recipe:

- 1/3 Personal development - 1/3 Collective intelligence - 1/3 Intrapreneurship - Bonus ingredient: some passionate colleagues
Your future projects 

Like Teddy, Business Analyst Business Intelligence at Cream, translate the BI needs of the business teams in specifications for the IT department, for both small demands or as part of larger projects (contributions or BI project). Your tasks will be

• Act as person of contact between Business Engineering Teams and the Development Team

• Define the business specifications for BI needs

• Participation in (or management of) BI projects, or on the BI tracks of other projects for the engineering activities (requirement definition, impact analysis, process definition), while representing the BI vision (and BI target architecture) that has been defined

• Collaboration with data delivery experts to deliver on projects

• Understand business requirements and build a functional analysis which covers needs of the business according to our BI reference architecture

• Collaborate with the development team

What do we expect from our Consultant ?

• You have a Master degree in Computer Sciences or equivalent by experience

• You have at least 2 years of experience in data and business analysis

• You have good knowledge in BI techniques and tools (BO, SAS, Cognos...)

• You have a cultural openness and adaptability, you are rigorous, customer oriented, and you have high communication skills and analytical skills

• You are polyvalent and can adapt easily to quickly changing environment

• You are capable to think out of the box and maintain in the meantime a pragmatic approach

• You are able to work with autonomy while being also a great team player

• You are fluent in French and English; a good knowledge of Dutch is an asset

• You are committed to travelling abroad occasionally upon the client's request

jobs.occupation: iDSB - International German School Brussels - Head of IT Coordination & Administration
jobs.description:
The purpose of this position is to ensure the daily operation, proper maintenance and development of information and communication systems in order to support a high-quality edcuation and an efficient administration of the school. This role becomes more important over time. A high quality IT infrastructure and very good user experience are distinction criteria for the school and therefore a leverage to reach our strategic long term objectives.

The position holder on the one hand needs to be capable of supporting the school staff with a clientoriented mindset on all IT related issues. On the other hand she/he needs to proactively advise on improvements of the IT Infrastructure, support the decision making process and implement such new solutions.
Your tasks (list is not exhaustive)

• Responsible for the daily operation of the School's Information- and Communication Infrastructure

• Maintenance of all Hard- and Software components used in the school (Server, Antivirus, Backups, wired and wireless networks, Firewalls, video conference equipment, endpoints, telephony).

• Ensure the security of all IT systems (apply security patches, manage configurations, ensure Anti-virus and other security updates)

• Ensure all required IT services are available during school hours (7:30 - 17:30) and on request also outside school hours through pro-active maintenance and SWIFT and effective troubleshooting

• Manage the school provided Mobile devices (laptops, tablets, smartphones, mobile phones)

• Management of Contracts: Software Licenses, Maintenance agreements, IT related leasing

• Installation of new systems (including testing, appropriate communication, training etc.)

• Assure connection to external specialists and leverage them as appropriate for the school

• User access Management (including setting up accounts for new users etc.)

• Creation and maintenance of complete documentation of all ICT systems (e.g. network structure, security architecture, overview of servers in operation, network components, end devices such as PCs, tablets, projectors, smartboards, monitors, ...)

• Proactively advise on system changes or new products, which could improve the IT landscape of the school, both in the area of software as well as Hardware

• Monitor and actively advise on developments in the educational environment (Germany, Belgium) as far as Technology in schools is concerned

• Act as an advisor on general IT topics for the school's headmaster and the administrative board

Organization / exposure

• The jobholder reports to the Head of Administration of the School.

• The position is complemented by a junior IT expert, who would report to the jobholder.

• Day-to-day contact with Teachers, administrative staff and students. Occasional contact with external stakeholders (Parents, Administration Board).

• Motivated IT allrounder with 3-5 years relevant experience

• Expertise in providing 1st Level support for a small to medium organization

• Expertise in Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Windows 10 and network technology

• Experience with selection and implementation of new hard- or software.

• Able to communicate with partners with limited IT background when proposing new solutions or changes to existing solutions

• Ideally some project management experience

• Proactivity - you find issues before they find you, eager to push things forward

• Problem Solving Skills

• Hands-on activities are your thing

• Client oriented mindset; self-organized but also a teamplayer

• Ability to prioritise; Adherence to deadlines

• Languages: solid knowledge of English; basic German; French and / or Dutch desirable but not mandatory

We are looking for an experienced and motivated crane operator to join our team. You will work in a 2-shift system and handle heavy loads safely and efficiently.

Your tasks:

• 
Operate overhead cranes and semi-portal cranes (up to 25 tons)

• 
Perform visual inspections and basic maintenance

• 
Follow safety rules at all times

• 
Work closely with your team to move materials

• 
Keep records of movements and incidents

Your profile:

• 
Experience with cranes, forklifts, or tower cranes

• 
A valid certificate is a plus (can also be obtained internally)

• 
Good technical skills and understanding of safety rules

• 
Willing to work in two shifts (early: 5:00-13:15 / late: 13:15-21:30)

• 
Team player, flexible, precise, and stress-resistant

• 
Good understanding of balance and load distribution

• 
Good Dutch or English skills

jobs.occupation: Order picker - night shift - English allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a true night owl who performs best during the night? Do you already have some experience in order picking or logistics? Are you looking for a physically challenging role with job security? Then this could be the perfect job for you!

For a stable and growing transport company in Oostkamp that specializes in frozen food logistics, we're looking for an order picker to join the team in the freezer in the night shift. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an order picker, you're the corner stone of the company's logistical processes. You work in the freezer every night to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

• Making orders based on order lists
• Preparing completed orders for shipment
• Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks
You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

• Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
• Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
• Feel at your absolute best at night and are looking for a night job
• Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)
Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

jobs.occupation: Multi-skilled maintenance technician - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician who's already living in Belgium? Do you have solid knowledge of electricity or electromechanics? And are you looking for a stable job in maintenance work with lots of variety? Then this might be the job for you!

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician with a strong background in electrical maintenance or electromechanics to help maintain the buildings, warehouse, technical installations, and outdoor areas of the company. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you play a key role in ensuring the reliability, safety, and operational performance of the infrastructure. You perform both the preventive and corrective maintenance of all the facilities, ensuring the logistical operations keep running safely and efficiently. Electricity is at the heart of the job, but you're also responsible for a wide range of general building maintenance.

Your key duties:

• Perform various kinds of repairs, replacements and maintenance works to the infrastructure of the company
• Carry out preventive technical controls on the various installations
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers
You'll sometimes need to go into the freezer warehouse, of course with the necessary thermal clothing.

Is this you?

• Education and/or experience in electrical maintenance, electromechanics or another relevent technical field
• Able to read electrical diagrams and schematics
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English, both spoken and written
• Already living in Belgium, preferably in the greater area of Oostkamp
Then please don't hesitate to apply, because this job could be yours!

Any other technical skills are a big plus but not required, e.g. mechanics, plumbing, HVAC...

Looking for a motivated Electrical Mechanic in Gent! 
Your tasks?

• Maintenance of electrical and mechanical systems.
• Troubleshooting and repairing machine malfunctions.
• Assembling, adjusting, and testing equipment.
• Performing preventive maintenance to avoid breakdowns

Who are you?

• You have knowledge on at least one of the following topics: 
• PLC
• Elektricity
• Hydraulics
• Pneumatics
• You speak English well
• You have your own transport
